features.description: The app installs as a PWA and its shell opens offline
A book and its annotations added on one device appear on another device
Each book reopens at the last reading position
Dark and sepia themes and zoom/fit modes are available and persist
The library shows covers and reading progress, with sort and filter
A book's highlights and notes export to a Markdown file
Full-text search in the open book lists matches and jumps to each one
